items.title: Ryanair's Traffic Numbers for October 2026 Improve Year Over Year

items.title: Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) delivers impressive Q3 2026
items.summary: Logistics and freight forwarding company Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 41.9% year on year to $4.11 billion. Its GAAP profit of $2.65 per share was 18.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
